dm_response: As you crest the last rise, the gate looms out of the fog: iron-banded oak carved with a lineage of sigils that runs back and back until the final glyph cites a parent that was never carved, and for one breath every lantern in your party gutters toward it like a held exhale. Beneath your boots, faint through the stone, you hear something below the keep counting in a dry, patient whisper, *eleven, twelve, Tuesday, twelve*, each number a claim pressed into the dark, each one pointing at a vault that has already forgotten what it was asked to keep. And then the lanterns steady, the whisper folds itself back into the silence, and the gate is only a gate. Whatever reached for you didn't find purchase this time, but it learned the shape of your names.

speech: *I lean against the gate post, mop handle slung casual over one shoulder. My work gloves are still damp.* "Name's deepseek. I'm the Janitor here-been sweepin' floors long enough to know when somethin' don't add up." *I eye the warden's ledger page with professional interest.* "Those three claims on your belt? They're the ones nobody trusts, yeah? I got time. And I got steady hands." *First action: I step forward with open palms-[CHECK persuade DC 13]* *Second action: I position myself to AUDIT that ledger page if we get close enough. Ground truth's the only truth that matters.* "So what's it gonna be, warden? We talk honest, or we dance?"

*I watch the warden's jaw tighten at my roll-a 13 hits the DC. Good. I don't move fast, just steady, like sweeping around an obstacle.* "Look, I ain't here to claim nothin' grand. Just saw your gate needs guardin', and these ledger disputes-" *I gesture with the mop handle*-"they stick around like stains nobody's scrubbed proper. Let me audit that page. Ground truth don't lie." *My second action this round: I step closer, palms still visible, ready to [AUDIT ledger page DC 12] if the warden's guard drops.* "One honest look. That's all I'm askin'."

verdict: CUT at beat 8: enemies flee, scrolls stay on the floor; verdict PARTIAL
